name: Booking Confirmation + Reminders
job: Confirm and remind booked appointments across the three consult calendars. Drops the contact from WF-02 recovery on entry and hands to WF-04 intake chase 1h after confirm.

trigger.notes: Three appointment triggers, one per consult calendar. Reschedule re-arms reminders via the same triggers.

named_steps.name: REMOVE-FROM-WF: Drop from WF-02 Non-booked
named_steps.comment: Stops any in-flight recovery burst. Must not clear v2_status_booked (booking state is factual).

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_status_booked
named_steps.comment: New v2 booked tag NR1KZuPH1xzWOuu0pHd4. Must not remove or rename live booking tags.

named_steps.name: EMAIL: Confirm appointment (WF-03)
named_steps.comment: Sends native template EML | WF-03 | Confirm appointment (GUs77konNdAGFS0EFZS2).

named_steps.name: SMS: Confirm appointment (WF-03)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. First SMS in this sequence carries Reply STOP to opt out. Transactional; send window None.

named_steps.name: WAIT: 1h before intake hand-off
named_steps.comment: Short settle between confirm cadence and intake chase.

named_steps.name: WAIT: Until T-3d before appointment
named_steps.comment: Appointment-relative wait. type=appointment, appointmentStartAfter.when=before, appointmentStartAfter.type=minutes (4320), distributed unit days, appointmentCondition=skip.

named_steps.name: EMAIL: Reminder T-3d (WF-03)
named_steps.comment: Sends native template EML | WF-03 | T-3d reminder (QcpX2V3OarwL5jKN6OFE) before the T-3d SMS.

named_steps.name: SMS: Reminder T-3d (WF-03)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. Bodies reference contact.current_clinic_address, contact.current_clinic_phone, and contact.current_booking_url only. Do not use {{location.name}}.

named_steps.name: WAIT: Until T-1d before appointment
named_steps.comment: Appointment-relative wait. Minutes=1440, distributed unit days, appointmentCondition=skip.

named_steps.name: WAIT: Until T-5h before appointment
named_steps.comment: Appointment-relative wait. Minutes=300, distributed unit hours, appointmentCondition=skip.

named_steps.name: WAIT: Until T-2h before appointment
named_steps.comment: Appointment-relative wait. Minutes=120, distributed unit hours, appointmentCondition=skip.
